QuestInfo.name: Vicious in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, could use some help. Maybe I should pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.1: #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat #r#o15#s#k and craft #b1 #t4003001##k.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to safely deliver the item #p208# asked for. At this point, I'd say I've proven myself to be a worthy apprentice.

0.0: Perfect timing. #p221# of #m10001000# mentioned she received a request from #m10004000# for a special item. I'm afraid I can't finish it in time on my own. Would you be able to help me?

yes.0: Thank you! What I need is #b#t4003001##k. It seems there aren't any carpenters in #m10004000#. You should be able to find #r#o15#s#k around #m10004000#, so it shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be looking forward to it.

no.0: You haven't forgotten that I'm your mentor... have you?

1.0: Great! This is exactly what I needed. I'm really glad I asked you for help.

yes.0: Here, as a reward, please take this #t2002006#. Using it should make training your woodcrafting skills a bit easier.
yes.1: But this is a bit of a problem... I have a feeling #p221# will keep sending me requests like this. It seems I may be relying on your help even more. I'll ask you again next time!

mob.0: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. We're short on time, so please hurry!

item.0: It looks like you don't have the material I asked for. We're short on time, so please hurry!
